detail.response: I remember that one, Alex. Your personal record in the half-marathon was 1 hour and 48 minutes, which you achieved in October 2025. That's a great time! Are you thinking of training for another race or trying to beat your current PR?
retrieved: Completed half-marathon in October 2025 with a PR of 1h 48m
